title: Whyfile result-envelope transport profile
description: [ENV-040] A transport credential is outside the core envelope and is validated as a separate profile. Validate the object with this schema and validate the projection without `graph_identity` against the core envelope schema.

graph_identity.description: [ENV-040] `graph_identity` is a transport credential block. [ENV-041] It is always present on this profile and is explicit null when no identity resolved.
